promises.quote: The practice of arresting officers risk assessments being formally completed prior to arrival at custody is inconsistent across forces. promises.summary: Implement nationally recognised pre-arrival risk assessments to improve communication of risks and concerns

promises.quote: It is recognised that there is a lack of information being recorded on custody detention logs. promises.summary: Adopt College of Policing Hydra packages to improve documentation on custody detention logs

promises.summary: Ensure compliance with PACE Code C for Appropriate Adult provision
